manual_required: C.member.app-password-sign-in 409 corner (No 2FA bypass): could not live-test end-to-end because it requires an `authenticate`-filter mu-plugin, and the run's hard constraints prohibit any Write besides the final report. Verified by code inspection only -- App_Credentials::translate_auth_error() (includes/auth/class-app-credentials.php:274-293) routes any wp_authenticate() error whose code is outside the 4 known credential-failure codes to WP_Error('wb_listora_second_factor', ..., 409), so a 2FA-refusing `authenticate` hook cannot fall through to a 200. Needs a real live pass with a 2FA plugin (or a temporary mu-plugin under a session with Write permission) before this corner can be marked release-verified.

false_positives_removed.why: Probe artefact. The agent called get_option('wb_listora_pro_webhook_strict_hmac') with no default; the code calls it WITH true as the default. Webhook_Receiver::is_strict_mode() returns true on this install - strict HMAC is ON. Not a bug.

resolved_during_release.resolution: FIXED in this release, not deferred. Root cause was two separate defects in the dedupe sweep: (1) its hook list named 'wb_listora_email_log_prune', a transposed name matching nothing, and omitted wb_listora_review_reminder_cron; (2) dedupe_pending_batch() takes ONE Action Scheduler group for the whole batch, so even a correct Pro hook name was swept against Free's 'wb-listora' group and found nothing. Now a hook=>group map behind the wb_listora_dedupe_recurring_hooks filter, with Pro registering its 7 jobs under 'wb-listora-pro'. Verified: a re-introduced duplicate is collapsed by a single ordinary front-end request.

coverage_note: TARGETED pass, not exhaustive: ~25 rows walked of ~183. The four 1.3.1 items (app-password sign-in, owner switch, custom badges, member self-delete) were verified end to end. Section B (upgrade) was not exercised at all.
